dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast series of distinct white spots arranged in segmented horizontal bands across the dark gray/black wing coverts and remiges.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent boundary contrast between high-luminance white spots and the dark feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Large, elongated, high-contrast white patch extending from the posterior neck area down the center of the back.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear transition from the dark crown to the start of the high-contrast white dorsal patch.
